verdict.rationale: Grok has a documented public xAI API that covers text generation, streaming, reasoning control, structured outputs, image and video generation, and service tiers, plus a quickstart. A live OpenAPI spec and an llms.txt index were both confirmed by probes (HTTP 200). One community report says Grok 4 struggled with agentic tool calling, but that concerns model quality, not whether the API exists. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.
